http://www.euronews.com/2026/08/30/us-fo.text: The US military has carried out fresh strikes on Iranian rocket launchers in the Strait of Hormuz, the Associated Press reported, citing a US official.The unnamed official, who spoke on the condition of anonymity, said Iranian Revolutionary Guards (IRGC) forces had been observed preparing to launch rockets with sea mines into the Strait.In a statement, the IRGC confirmed strikes had hit Larak Island, resulting in an unspecified number of casualties, per Iran's Fars news agency.It also warned that the attack would be "met with a retaliatory response."The strikes mark the US's first military action in the Strait in a month.US Central Command leader Admiral Brad Cooper announced earlier this week that Iranian sea mines had been "successfully cleared" from the Strait's international shipping lanes.The Strait of Hormuz is a crucial energy transit chokepoint that usually carries around a quarter of the world’s seaborne oil trade. Iran effectively closed the waterway following US and Israeli strikes in late February, and it has since become a key sticking point in negotiations between Washington and Tehran.

https://www.gratefulweb.com/articles/scr.text: SCREAM Edmonton Expands to Two Nights for Biggest Edition Yet Article Contributed by Gratefulweb Published on 2026-08-20 For 27 years, Halloween in Edmonton has meant one thing: SCREAM . What began in 1999 as a single night at the Polish Hall, with legendary DJ and producer John Acquaviva performing for roughly 1,000 fans, has evolved into one of the largest and longest-running Halloween celebrations in North America, produced by Boodang. This October 30–31, SCREAM EDMONTON returns to the Edmonton EXPO Centre for its biggest edition yet, expanding to two nights, four stages, more than 228,000 square feet of festival space and an expected 30,000+ guests over two days from across Canada, the United States and beyond. The 2026 edition brings together an international lineup spanning the full spectrum of electronic music, including Tiesto, Alesso, Chase & Status, Gryffin, Sara Landry, Sullivan King, SVDDEN DEATH, Andrew Rayel, KREAM, Matroda, HNTR, Wax Motif, Odd Mob, alongside 27 supporting DJs across greater Canada. Across two nights and four distinct stages, SCREAM offers something for virtually every corner of dance music. Elm Street, the festival’s main stage, brings cathedral-scale production and some of the biggest names in the genre, spanning progressive and future house. Camp Crystal Lake plunges into dubstep, drum & bass and heavy bass, while Monsterhaus operates as a club within the festival, delivering bass house, tech house and high-energy underground sounds. At Sanctuary, trance collides with hard techno, hard dance and hardstyle for an experience built around euphoric builds and punishing drops. For 2026, SCREAM is expanding its physical footprint and reimagining the guest experience to match its growth. The Edmonton EXPO Centre will feature 228,000+ square feet of festival space, wider walkways, improved ventilation, expanded amenities, indoor queueing and a redesigned entry experience with multiple lanes to accommodate the festival’s growing audience. Stadium-level sound, cathedral-scale lighting rigs, massive laser displays and towering LED walls will create an environment built for maximum impact. Beyond the music, more than 200 live performers spanning dancers, stilt-walkers, aerialists and costumed characters will transform the venue into a fully immersive Halloween world. Across two nights, SCREAM will bring together 30,000+ attendees for a celebration that is equal parts dance festival, Halloween spectacle and longstanding Edmonton tradition. Tickets are on sale now, ranging from GA, GA+, VIP and Ultra VIP at screamhalloween.ca . Follow SCREAM EDMONTON: Instagram | Website About SCREAM EDMONTON: Founded in 1999, SCREAM EDMONTON is one of North America’s longest-running Halloween festivals and a defining institution in Edmonton’s electronic music culture. What began at the Polish Hall with approximately 1,000 attendees has grown into a destination Halloween experience attracting more than 10,000 fans annually and welcoming attendees from across Canada, the United States and beyond. Known for its world-class electronic music lineups, immersive production, elaborate Halloween environments and diverse programming across multiple stages, SCREAM has evolved across nearly three decades while maintaining its roots in community, self-expression and dance music culture. The 2026 edition marks a new milestone with two nights, four stages, 228,000+ square feet of festival space and an expected 30,000+ guests. About Boodang: Boodang is a Western Canadian event production company with more than two decades of experience creating some of the region’s most influential dance music events and festivals. Founded in 1999, the company has built a legacy around connecting audiences with both emerging talent and internationally acclaimed artists including Tiesto, ZHU and Gorgon City, while championing inclusive, immersive experiences rooted in dance music culture. Boodang was instrumental in establishing Edmonton as a major destination for electronic music, pioneering large-scale dance music events and working collaboratively with the city to help build a lasting community around the culture. Its portfolio includes SCREAM, Canada’s longest-standing Halloween festival, as well as Elements Music Festival, Frequency, Pure and Bomfest. With a focus on distinctive brands, ambitious production and community-driven experiences, Boodang continues to shape the dance music landscape across Western Canada.
